title: 第九章猪仙人第十章战猪妖
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
lines: 张守安拍了拍老人的肩膀，说道：“你知道那只妖在哪吗？”
老人一愣，伸出脏手，擦了擦眼角的泪水，指着右前方的一处方向：“就在那边。”
他也不知道为什么今天的自己，居然如此失态，还是在一位仙长面前。
若是换成前几日那些仙长，估计会一边骂着自己唠叨事多，一边用棍棒抽打自己。
可他就是觉得，此时就该一吐为快，他忍了一辈子，这几句话说出去后，就算是死，也值了。
反正自己已经活够了。
张守安握紧剑柄，从一侧走出，他路过老人时，嘴里轻声道：
“我知道了。”
老人怔了几秒，而后猛地转头，看着那张背影，拐杖上的手指攥得越来越紧。
村中央，有座古宅，据说主人的主上曾是位状元，暮年回到村里，修建了这座宅邸。
不过经过世代的变迁，家族也渐渐没落，独留几根独苗，守着这么大的屋子。
甚至现在，连这处屋子都守不住了。早早让猪妖夺了过去，还自诩为猪仙人，赐名该院神仙居。
神仙居，神仙居，屋内所住，真仙人。
正午，院子的大门紧紧关闭，里面生长着杂乱的荒草。看来是许久无人打理，显得一团脏乱。
可谁知，那本该寂静无声的主屋内竟传出阵阵异响，若是普通人，也许会以为是老鼠的声音。
可张守安站在门口，却知道屋内有什么东西。
他走过屋院，径直来到主屋门前，一脚踹开。
“砰！”老旧的大门轰然碎开，撞在后面的墙上，发出一声巨响。
尘土飞扬，不久就露出里面的一切。
屋内家具散乱一地，尽数毁坏，地面上，横七竖八地倒着七八个人的身体，并不完整，咕咕恶臭从里面散发出来，直冲人鼻。
他们双目浑圆，表情上写满着惊恐，眼白占据着整个双眼，鼻尖早已没有了呼吸，不过他们的目光却是直直瞅向一个方向。
顺着他们的视线看去，可以看见一张木制床榻，上面瘫坐着一位肥硕身影，扯得七零八落的帘子垂下，微微挡住它半个身子。
它身着一件灰色大袍，上面沾满油渍。袍子敞开，扯到肚皮，露出里面油腻的肥肉。
它的胸口处显露出一片乌黑锃亮的鬃毛，伴随着流淌下来的口水，有几处明显打结在一起。
不过最为突兀的是它的头部，一张丑陋肥硕的猪头从帘子后面显露，它鼻孔朝天，往外喷出一股热气，化作白烟。
它手里抓着半截手臂，显然是来自人类，上面正不断滴着鲜血，染红了它的嘴唇。
它哼哧哼哧的咀嚼着，床榻也因为这小小的动作响个不停。
张守安扫视了几眼，步步朝里走进。
微弱的“嗒嗒”声在屋内响起，打断了猪妖手里的动作，它一手拨开帘子，从里面探出整张猪头。
它的视线扫过眼前的一切，最后才落到那道小小的身影上。
它眼里瞬间闪过一抹疑惑，嗓音粗犷地问道：
“郑雅派你来的？”
猪妖来回扫视了几眼张守安，最后“哼”了一声。
“真好歹她还记得我这里，上回送来那几个，瘦成什么了，嚼着都塞牙。”
它抱怨了几句，好似受了多大的委屈。
最后却是又笑了出来，伸出肥硕的手，招呼张守安过去：“好了，让我看看今天的贡品。”
content_en:
Zhang Shou'an patted the old man's shoulder and said, "Do you know where that monster is?"
The old man was stunned, stretched out his dirty hands, wiped the tears from the corners of his eyes, and pointed to a direction in front of him on the right: "It's over there."
He didn't know why he was so rude today, in front of an immortal.
If it were those immortal leaders from the past few days, they would probably beat themselves with sticks while scolding themselves for nagging.
But he just felt that it was time to let it out. He had endured it all his life. After saying these words, even if he died, it would be worth it.
Anyway, I have lived enough.
Zhang Shou'an clenched the hilt of his sword and walked out from one side. When he passed the old man, he whispered:
"I understand."
The old man was stunned for a few seconds, then turned his head sharply and looked at the back, the fingers on the crutches clenching tighter and tighter.
In the center of the village, there is an ancient house. It is said that the owner's boss was once a champion. He returned to the village in his later years and built this house.
However, after generations of changes, the family gradually declined, leaving only a few single seedlings guarding such a large house.
Even now, even this house cannot be defended. The pig demon took it away early, and he claimed to be the Pig Immortal and named the courtyard the Immortal Residence.
The residence of the gods, the residence of the gods, the people who live in the house are truly immortals.
At noon, the gate of the courtyard was tightly closed, and there were messy weeds growing inside. It seemed that no one had taken care of it for a long time and it looked a mess.
But who would have expected that there were bursts of strange noises coming from the supposedly silent main room. An ordinary person might have thought it was the sound of mice.
But Zhang Shouan stood at the door, but he knew what was inside the house.
He walked through the courtyard, went straight to the door of the main house, and kicked it open.
"Bang!" The old door burst open and hit the wall behind, making a loud noise.
Dust flew up, soon revealing everything inside.
The furniture in the house was scattered all over the place, and all of it was destroyed. On the ground, seven or eight people's bodies were lying scattered, incomplete, and a foul stench emanated from inside, hitting people's noses.
Their eyes were round, and their expressions were filled with fear. The whites of their eyes occupied their entire eyes, and the tips of their noses were no longer breathing, but their eyes were looking straight in one direction.
Following their line of sight, they could see a wooden bed, with a fat figure sitting slumped on it, and the torn curtains hung down, slightly blocking half of its body.
It was wearing a gray robe, stained with oil. The robe was open and pulled down to the belly, exposing the greasy fat underneath.
A piece of shiny black mane was exposed on its chest, with saliva flowing down, and several spots were obviously knotted together.
But the most abrupt thing is its head. An ugly and fat pig's head is revealed from behind the curtain. Its nostrils are pointed toward the sky, and it spits out a stream of hot air, which turns into white smoke.
It was holding half of an arm, which was obviously from a human. It was dripping with blood, staining its lips red.
It hummed and chewed, and the bed kept making noises because of this small movement.
Zhang Shou'an glanced at it a few times and walked in step by step.
A weak "tap-tap" sound resounded in the room, interrupting the movements of the pig demon's hand. It opened the curtain with one hand and poked out the entire pig's head from inside.
Its gaze swept over everything in front of it, and finally fell on that small figure.
A flash of doubt flashed in its eyes, and it asked in a rough voice:
"Zheng Ya sent you here?"
"Yeah."
The pig demon glanced back and forth at Zhang Shou'an a few times, and finally let out a "hum".
"It's a good thing she still remembers me. The ones I sent last time were so skinny that their teeth were filled with chewing."
It complained a few words, as if it had been wronged a lot.
In the end, he laughed again, stretched out his fat hand, and called Zhang Shou'an over: "Okay, let me see today's tribute."
